name: jack-cheng-marketplace
description: Jack Cheng's Claude Code plugins: small, install-what-you-need plugins for prompting, code review, git shipping and HTML explainers, plus reading & writing skills from 《写作的真相》.

plugins.name: jack-prompting
plugins.description: Prompt-side helpers used before any code: iyow restates the user's goal and the problem behind it in your own words, so misunderstandings surface before work starts.

plugins.name: course-exporter
plugins.description: Export online courses into local notes: songy-course-exporter merges a Songy course's audio and 课程文本 into one folder; xvast-subtitle-capture captures an Xvast video's burned-in subtitles and PPT slides into a per-slide Markdown transcript.

plugins.name: writing-truth
plugins.description: Reading & writing skills from Li Xiaolai's 《写作的真相》: dissect-author-mind (L1), logic-template-lens (L4), rhetoric-lens (L5).

plugins.name: jack-work
plugins.description: Knowledge-work skills for research, investment and consulting output: interview-notes syncs raw interview transcripts into a consolidated Q&A memo additively; jc-basic-report builds a VC basic-information report as one self-contained HTML (Kami design, sidebar TOC, annotations, browser tests); expense-reimbursement turns receipts into filled reimbursement forms with rule checks.
